description: Executed grounding for qr-camo-embed: the committed adapter runs the frozen blend script (the exact bytes eval-6 shipped) on six cases — ship, ship repeat, short-URL variant, payload overflow, dark cover, pale cover — and fourteen deterministic gates judge the observation against the evidence the run itself left behind: byte-exact oracle reproduction, the stress ladder, the measured dark-cover halo lift and pale-cover signature, the sealed muse receipts, the cv2-vs-zxing separation, the pre-fix orientation behavior, determinism, interpreter and source identity.
notes: This package makes the executed-grounding claim for qr-camo-embed concrete: the
frozen script make_header_v2.py (capabilities/qr-camo-embed/adapter/make_header_v2.py,
sha256 8dc1960468b002dde416d8f27fa5f07fb97febcd015198674fc3f92c4550bdeb — byte-identical
to the script eval-6 shipped) is executed by the committed adapter on six cases, and the
observation the adapter writes is judged against evidence the run left behind, not
against a narrative.
Byte reproduction is the spine of the claim: the ship case (bearing cover,
https://archon.diy) must reproduce oracle-ship-header.png byte for byte — the exact
bytes eval-6 shipped after the muse llm gate returned VERDICT: SHIP — and the pale
case must reproduce oracle-pale-header.png byte for byte. The oracles are committed
fixtures; the gates compare hashes, and artifact_identity_pinned proves all copies of
every fixture agree across the package, the run work dir and the run evidence copy.
Oracle provenance is stated, not hidden: the ship oracle IS the shipped eval-6
output. The pale oracle was produced in the pre-orientation-fix era of the script;
the portrait code path it exercised (scale, placement search, adaptive gains, stress
ladder) is identical in both revisions, and today's frozen script reproduces those
bytes exactly. The landscape behavior the orientation fix changed is pinned by the
prefix-orientation fixture (the script as eval-4/eval-5 ran it) and demonstrated by
orientation_fix_bites: same cover, same URL, different placement line and a refusal
the fixed script does not produce — the fix is shown as a behavior change, not
asserted in prose.
The interpreter is environment, not capability bytes: evidence/qr-venv is gitignored,
and a clean room reproduces the run by pointing RCOS_QR_PYTHON at any interpreter
whose live dependency probe returns the pinned versions (interpreter_declared re-probes
through the interpreter the cases actually recorded). Pinned versions: cv2 4.13.0,
qrcode 8.2, zxingcpp 3.1.1 (dist zxing-cpp), numpy 2.4.6, pillow 10.4.0, python 3.14.7.
The muse llm-gate verdicts are historical records and are pinned, not re-run:
muse-eval6-ship.log and muse-eval5-fail.log are byte-copies of
evidence/qr-camo-embed/eval-6/muse-gate.log and eval-5/muse-gate.log;
muse_receipts_sealed checks the copies and the home originals agree and carry the
VERDICT lines. This package does not re-decide whether an embed is artistically
acceptable — pale_cover_signature measures the pale-cover geometry (ring lift, box
delta) but leaves the taste ruling where it happened, in the registry history.
cv2 is never an oracle: decode_controls.py measures the cv2-vs-zxing separation on the
ship output at fades 0.10/0.15/0.20 and cv2_weaker_than_zxing pins the measured
direction — at 0.15 zxing still decodes the URL while cv2 already misses, and no leg
has cv2 succeeding where zxing fails. The stress ladder helper mirrors the script's own
stress_pass: zxing-only, on decoded pixel arrays, never on encoded buffers.
The measuring helpers replicate frozen behavior rather than trust it: measure_blend.py
re-implements the script's canvas pipeline (its lines 29-35) and stress_ladder.py its
stress ladder (its lines 96-107); both, the decode controls, the adapter, the contract
and the frozen script are hash-pinned on disk by frozen_source_pinned. check.js cannot
pin its own bytes — its identity is carried by the commit and the trace receipt, as
with every checker in this repo.
Refusals are exercised, not assumed: the overflow case must exit 1 with the exact
'payload too long' stderr line and no output file, and the prefix-orientation case
must exit 1 with the exact 'no contrast level survived the stress ladder' line (em
dash included). The adapter records outcome=refused without judging which refusal it
saw; these gates read the streams.
Determinism is claimed only as observed: determinism_repeat requires the repeat case
to reproduce the ship case's bytes and stdout exactly. The covers are committed
fixtures, the script has no randomness, and independent invocations reproduced the
oracles byte for byte before this package was written.
Measurement tolerances come from executed runs, not wishes: dark_cover must lift the
QR ring luma by at least 50 units relative to the ship embedding (measured 78.18),
must land the ring inside [70,110] (measured 90.09) and below the ship canvas ring
(measured 30.81 vs 144.09); pale_cover must hold |box_delta| <= 10 (measured 2.51)
with ring44_delta >= 5 (measured 15.77) and ring inside [95,125] (measured 108.8).
The thresholds carry margin around the measured values but are not vacuous: swapping
the cover, the output or the placement breaks them.
Placement lines are pinned as observed and cross-checked: the ship/variant cases
placed at (1065,60) score 25.5, dark at (1065,20) score 40.9, pale at (905,20) score
32.2, all 37x37 modules — placement depends on the cover, and the gates require the
stdout lines verbatim rather than re-deriving the search.
Historical linkage: this package replaces nothing. eval-1 through eval-6 under
evidence/qr-camo-embed/ remain the historical record of the capability's development,
including eval-5's FAIL; the executed receipt lands additively beside them and no
historical eval is rewritten to reflect this result.
Reproduced, not invented: every oracle, receipt, placement and measurement this
package pins was captured from runs that happened before the package was written.
Nothing here awards the capability a new grade by itself — the grade is the auditor's
call on the receipt this package produces.
